page_title: MON 1-0 PSG | Monaco v PSG 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner.
90+5' The foul by Jordan Teze (Monaco) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Clement Turpin.
90+4' Lamine Camara (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' A yellow card for a tackle by Krepin Diatta (Monaco). Clement Turpin doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Referee Clement Turpin halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Sebastien Pocognoli, then shows him a yellow.
86' Sebastien Pocognoli has decided to make a change. Paul Pogba (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
85' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Mika Biereth.

85' Ousmane Dembele plays a lovely pass into Quentin Ndjantou (PSG), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
83' Substitution. Fabian Ruiz is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
80' We have witnessed a sending off. Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) is shown a red card and it's an early bath for him I guess.
80' He’s off! Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) gets his marching orders from referee Clement Turpin after the VAR review.

80' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Thilo Kehrer (Monaco), but referee Clement Turpin must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
76' The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) coming on for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
76' The ball is cleared after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
72' Sebastien Pocognoli decides to make a substitution. Aleksandr Golovin will be replaced by Ansu Fati (Monaco).
68' 1 - 0 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin provides Takumi Minamino (Monaco) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
67' Wonderful movement by Monaco. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vanderson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
64' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Senny Mayulu and he is replaced by Quentin Ndjantou (PSG).
64' It will be a substitution. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is ready to enter the pitch as Kang-In Lee walks off.
63' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
62' PSG players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
61' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lamine Camara (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
60' A pass by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
56' Ball possession – 44:56.
55' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
49' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
49' The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.

48' Vanderson (Monaco) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
40' Lamine Camara (Monaco) will take the corner.
36' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Vitinha (PSG) for a tough tackle.

28' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom right corner, but Lucas Chevalier is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
27' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Vitinha (PSG) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Lukas Hradecky stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
25' Kang-In Lee (PSG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
22' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save.
20' Kang-In Lee (PSG) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Khvicha Kvaratskhelia with a fine lofted pass.
19' Neat passing move from Monaco in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Monaco will take a throw-in.
13' Lucas Chevalier (PSG) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
12' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
12' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Lamine Camara (Monaco) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
11' Lukas Hradecky is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Joao Neves (PSG). Easy save!
10' Vanderson (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.

4' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He drilled a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulled off an astonishing save to deny him.
4' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
1' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
